mission.title: New Concerns
mission.description: Question the Agents about their attacks.

npc.say: It is time that you left. I have matters to attend to.
PC Load Letter? What the hell does that mean?!
Peter didn't come into work today. If he's not careful, he's going to get fired.
I'm getting worried, Jani Detriech.... First Danial Marin is dead and then Alvaro Seminatore in the same hour! I'm worried that we're going to be next...
You may be right. I haven't seen Peter come into work for a week! I think he has the right idea...
You want to know what happened here? Well, I have my theories but I don't think anyone would believe me...
Let me get back to my work.

phase.briefing: The attacks from Agents are becoming a great concern to the Merovingian and we need you, among others, to track down Agents and question them about these attacks. We're sending you the address of an office complex where Agent Lee is currently wrapping up some business involving an incident that happened just an hour ago. Since Agent Lee is among bluepills it's our hope that we'll be able to speak with him and learn something about these new Agents.

enter.say: This is the office complex where Agent Lee can be found. Seek him out and speak with him.

talk.say:
You seem to claim that we have been meddling in your affairs, Mr. {player}. This shows just how little you are aware of.
Pay careful attention to these individuals and their actions... you may be able to uncover what we have not...

Agent Lee may be right about their involvement but why would we want to believe them? They are all Machines!
Enough of that for now, we have something urgent that has come up. We've located an attack in progress and need you to get there quickly. Flood will update you as you make your way there.

phase.briefing: The address is being sent to you now. The location is a meeting of some sort involving another organization and these Agents are descending upon the place as we speak.

enter.say: I think the best approach would be to try and speak with all of the Agents before breaking into combat and getting yourself killed. We can't have you taking a fall now.

talk.say: Your pathetic attempt at salvation will fall short.
Enough of this... It ends now.

done.say: Think about this for a minute... If the Agents attacked the Zion Operatives for no plausible reason, wouldn't they be breaking the Truce between them? This is a cause for concern, even for the Merovingian and the allied Exiles. I'll report this to Flood immediately.

mission.finish: I saw the report, {player}... You did well. Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment.
